_why: Scripts that exist but are NOT in the publish queue, held on purpose until
the Saturday gate decides whether to promote them. Retired by this flag,
never by deletion: every script named here stays where it is.
2026-09-23. The Monday lane authored four mined-demand topics on 2026-09-21
into loop/drafts/ and loop/render_queue.json. None is in any
research/publish_order*.json, none passed the demand gate, and the Mac's
nightly batch reads only the publish queue, so they could never air. The
owner decided (06:05 CDT): the Monday lane writes ONLY topics already in
the publish queue (loop/rank.py and loop/draft.py enforce it); these four
are not queued for the Mac and not deleted; the subject waits for her
promotion decision.
WHO READS THIS. loop/batch_queue.py promotion_holds() is the only reader.
loop/cloud_upload.py uses it so an empty shelf with these scripts waiting
is the green, named SCRIPTS_AWAITING_PROMOTION stop (self-resolving), not
a daily AUTHORED_NOT_QUEUED page. loop/rank.py and loop/draft.py refuse to
select or queue a held slug.
HOW A HOLD ENDS. 2026-09-25, owner instruction: a hold is not a decision
for her - 'why can't these be left somewhere for an automated process to
pick up and decide on?' So loop/score.py dispose_promotion_holds() runs
every Saturday, after the ranking refresh, and puts each held script's
own question through the same demand-and-competition gate every queued
topic passed (research/publish_order_domain.py --query). Passed, or the
slug is already a queued row that passed: PROMOTED - the script goes to
scripts/<slug>.md, a gated row is appended to its domain's
research/publish_order*.json, its POV line is recorded, and the row here
is removed. Killed: DECLINED - the script moves to loop/drafts/declined/,
the row here is removed. Both are appended to docs/DECISION-LOG.md. If the
gate cannot run (no YouTube key, quota) the row stays and its
gate_deferred count rises; four deferrals is the HOLD_GATE_FAILED stop.
This file is the one thing loop code edits here, and only that way.
